tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (3 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Three-drone coordination exercise: Drone 1, Drone 2, and Drone 3 take off together to 18 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (491, 414, 18), (833, 512, 18), and (600, 875, 18) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all three drones move north for 83m, and next move east for 65m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 83m, then east 65m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

All drones must complete the full directional distance (north 83m, east 65m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Three-drone formation drill: launch Drone 1, Drone 2, and Drone 3 to altitude 18m, hold stations at (491, 414, 18), (833, 512, 18), and (600, 875, 18) respectively, then shift north by 83 meters and east by 65 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute synchronized operation with Drone 1, Drone 2, Drone 3: take off reaching 18 meters height, maintain formation at coordinates (491, 414, 18), (833, 512, 18), and (600, 875, 18) respectively, then proceed north for 83m and subsequently east for 65m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.

Three-drone coordinated maneuver: Drone 1, Drone 2, and Drone 3 lift off to 18m elevation, hold formation positions at (491, 414, 18), (833, 512, 18), and (600, 875, 18) respectively, then travel north 83 meters and east 65 meters in sequence.
